ideas.pitch: A predictive analytics platform for university campuses that forecasts maintenance bottlenecks, safety incidents, and resource crunches using Poisson regression and rolling backtests.
ideas.title: CampusIncidentForecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies the proven architecture of GitHub project 1087704265 to a relatable offline campus context, hitting the Open Innovation track criteria with robust, rigorous math.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace and multi-step workflow manager designed to handle student club budget approvals and vendor negotiations using tool-calling loops.
ideas.title: AgenticProcure
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the Agentic Harness track by implementing genuine autonomous agent workflows rather than a simple wrapper chatbot, mirroring the marketplace success seen in GitHub project 1185920891.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent student support and sustainability compliance platform that coordinates autonomous agents to monitor energy usage and provide personalized conservation recommendations.
ideas.title: EcoCampusMultiAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines the Agentic Harness track requirements with multi-agent architecture patterns proven in GitHub project 1213911408, providing clear, quantifiable real-world impact for judges.

ideas.pitch: A graph-intelligence powered supply chain audit platform that flags fraudulent agricultural subsidies and vendor anomalies using explainable gradient-boosted trees.
ideas.title: AgriGraphAML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly adapts the high-performing financial crime and graph intelligence stack from GitHub project 1181344931 to solve a critical agricultural supply chain problem in the Open Innovation track.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite imagery monitoring platform that tracks unauthorized construction and land usage changes across vast university campus boundaries.
ideas.title: SatelliteCampusMonitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a concrete infrastructural challenge using geospatial computer vision, duplicating the technical ambition that won the runner-up prize in GitHub project 1155558847.
